subject: MAP: Eval plan & capacity timing for Dedicated/Private deployment
messages:
From: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@nimbushealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week. Nimbus is preparing an evaluation for our clinical NLP extraction pipeline (PHI redaction + entity extraction). We'd like to put a Mutual Action Plan together that includes: a 4-week pilot, clear success criteria (precision/recall benchmarks), and a capacity reservation plan if we decide to move to Dedicated or Private.

Key constraints:
- Evaluation window: target July start (2nd half)
- Regulatory: SOC2 + HIPAA evidence required for Private deployment
- Procurement lead times: our internal committee requires an 8–10 week procurement review for vendor contracts

I've attached a short requirements summary (Nimbus_REQ_v1.pdf). Can your team propose MAP milestones and an initial sizing estimate (GPUs, expected concurrency) we can share with procurement?

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Data Science, Nimbus Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Samantha —

Appreciate the context and the requirements doc. I've drafted a starter MAP (attached MAP-draft.xlsx) that splits the engagement into: kickoff, pilot (4 weeks), evaluation review, procurement alignment, and go/no-go for Dedicated vs Private. Monica (SE) is looped in for sizing assumptions and a technical checklist.

High-level ask for your team before we lock the MAP:
- Expected average request size (tokens) and tokens-per-minute during the pilot
- Top-level SLA/latency targets (p95 latency we should aim for)
- Any on-prem constraints if you prefer Private (networking window, air-gapped requirements)

Can we schedule a 30-min workshop this week to confirm numbers? I'm available Thu 6/18 or Fri 6/19.

Best,
Aditya Rao

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@nimbushealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Samantha / Aditya —

Attaching a short sizing CSV (sizing-assumptions.csv) and a set of assumptions we used to build the MAP-draft. Summary: based on the requirements doc and a typical clinical-extraction workload we recommend the following starting point for the 4-week pilot and an initial Dedicated pool estimate.

Assumptions (pilot):
- Model: ~70B decoder model quantized to 8-bit (for parity with your accuracy targets)
- Avg tokens per request: 1,200 (pre-/post-processing included)
- Target concurrency during pilot: 20 concurrent requests
- Expected requests/sec at peak: ~8 rps (burst to 20)
- Target p95 latency: <700ms for extraction path

Pilot recommendation (hosted evaluation):
- 2 x H100 (or 4 x A100-80GB equivalent) dedicated for the pilot with managed KV-cache + prefix caching enabled. This gives consistent p95s while we exercise the model and prompts.

Dedicated/Private production sizing (starting point):
- If production needs to sustain 50–80 concurrent requests (roughly 6–10x pilot load) we estimate a pool of 8 H100s (or ~16 A100-80GB equivalents) to meet latency SLOs with some headroom for autoscaling/bursting.
- For heavy burst patterns (short peaks 100–150 concurrent) add an additional 4 GPU burst pool behind a routing policy.

Lead times:
- Hosted Dedicated (cloud) reserved pool: 2–4 weeks to reserve & configure once contract is agreed and payment cleared.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) initial deployment: 8–12 weeks (includes network setup, KMS/HSM integration and audits).

I can go deeper on batching strategies and KV cache tuning in the workshop.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@nimbushealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Thanks — that helps a lot. Procurement is on the thread; their big asks are: (1) fixed pilot cost estimate to include in our internal request, and (2) clarity on the earliest possible cutover date if we choose Dedicated vs Private. Procurement notes our committee meeting 7/29.

We updated the MAP draft with our internal gating and dates — attaching Nimbus_MMAP.xlsx. Two follow-ups: can you confirm whether the pilot GPUs can be reserved (hold) pending procurement so we don't get blocked by supply? And what fallback options exist if H100 inventory is constrained?

Best,
Samantha
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@nimbushealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Samantha —

Appreciate the MAP update. I've attached a preliminary commercial package (commercial_proposal_ND-4732.pdf) that outlines three options:

1) Pilot-only (4 weeks) — flat fee + metered overage. Pilot capacity: 2 H100s reserved for the pilot window.
2) Dedicated Starter (12-month commit) — suggested pool: 8 H100 equivalent, 18% discount vs on-demand. Faster provisioning guaranteed (we reserve hardware capacity on signing).
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — higher onboarding fee, full compliance package (SOC2/HIPAA attestation support), and an estimated 8–12 week delivery timeline.

Regarding inventory holds: we can place a provisional reservation once we have an LOI and a small commitment deposit. That reduces the allocation lead time materially and lets us lock hardware for your pilot window. If H100 inventory is tight, we can initially stage with A100-80GB equivalent instances and plan a swap to H100 as they become available; performance tests will be run during the pilot to validate parity.

Next commercial step: LOI or pilot order form. I can circulate standard LOI language if you'd like.

-Lauren
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-30T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation cluster & timing

Samantha —

From a CS/onboarding perspective, here's a compact onboarding checklist to make the pilot low-friction:
- Prework: access list, sample dataset (anonymized) and eval prompts
- Provisioning: confirm target pilot window and LOI so we can place a provisional reservation
- Acceptance tests: 10 sample documents, target precision >= 0.92 and recall >= 0.88 for named entity extraction
- Observability: we'll enable trace-level logging and the Redwood Console dashboard for token-level breakdowns during the pilot

I'll host a 45-min kickoff session with your engineering and security leads to go through network/VPC requirements and a runbook for the pilot. Proposed kickoff: Tue 7/21 9am PT. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Nimbus/MAP-v3

—Rohan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Please attach SOC2 Type II evidence and a sample DPA. We are timeboxed to present to our committee on 2026-07-29.

Procurement Team

Procurement / Samantha —

Thanks for the redlines and timeline constraints. Quick responses and proposed next steps: 
1) SOC2/DPA: attaching SOC2 reference and a DPA template in the shared Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Nimbus/MAP-v3). We'll also drop a SOC2 attestation PDF into that folder by EOD 7/6.
2) Lead time: we can meet a 6-week cutover for Dedicated if Nimbus is willing to sign an LOI + refundable pilot deposit. That allows us to place a provisional hardware reservation and accelerate configuration.
3) Pilot reservation: we'll hold the 2 H100 pilot capacity for your July pilot window on receipt of the LOI + deposit. If H100s are unavailable we will provision with A100-80GB equivalents and complete a performance swap test as part of the pilot.

Proposed MAP update: lock LOI by 7/10 -> pilot window 7/20–8/17 -> procurement committee review 7/29 -> target Dedicated cutover (if go) 6 weeks after signature (earliest 8/28). Updating the MAP spreadsheet and attaching MAP-final-v3.xlsx.

Action items:
- Nimbus: confirm LOI intent and pass any internal purchase order process details to Procure (procure@nimbushealth.com)
- Redwood: deliver SOC2 doc by 7/06 and finalize pilot order form by 7/08

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow to finalize language.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
